title: Deterministic checks for Claude Code (opt-in)
description: Rule-based hooks and scripts, no model calls: a fast syntax/control-character check after each file edit, a done-check that sends Claude back once when it changed code after its last test or build, a cached project map at session start, plus session-stats.mjs (per-session numbers for before/after comparisons) and safe-commit.mjs (commit after attribution, secret and private-pattern checks; terminal only).
postInstall: Claude checks: start a new Claude Code session to load the hooks. Opt out per project with .claude/checks-off, everywhere with CLAUDE_CHECKS=0. Project maps are cached in ~/.agents/cache/project-maps/. Scripts in ~/.agents/tools/checks/: session-stats.mjs [--days 7] [--project x]; safe-commit.mjs -F msg [-C repo] [--push] [--sign] (run in your own terminal; add private regexes to ~/.config/llm-config/private-patterns).
